instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'recharts' for the message volume chart on the dashboard.
Implement 'framer-motion' for subtle page transitions and list item entrances.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Use the provided image URLs for the login page background and empty states.
For the HL7 message preview, use a monospace font and preserve whitespace.
Maintain a strict 'Clean Blue' theme. Avoid gradients for backgrounds unless specified.
Do NOT use 'alert()' or default browser confirms. Use Shadcn Dialogs.
Ensure the sidebar is collapsible on mobile.
Use 'date-fns' for date formatting in the Audit Trail.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays only.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
